title: RouteError
summary: An Error with normalized HTTP response details.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body: Extends Error with status, statusText, and optional data. Use isRouteErrorResponse to narrow an unknown failure before reading those fields.

sections.title: Usage and limits
sections.body: Not every loader failure is an HTTP error. Ordinary Error values have no guaranteed status. JSON action validation data returned through data(...) remains action data rather than automatically becoming a RouteError.
